provenance.procedure: GET /tv/900?append_to_response=external_ids with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb tv-900.
provenance.note: Synthesised: a series' detail with external_ids appended. Unlike a movie it carries imdb_id ONLY under external_ids, beside tvdb_id as a NUMBER — the shape the client must read for a followed series' TVDB id to be confirmed. backdrop_path is null so the result's BackdropURL must be empty, never a poster standing in.
